epics.title: Telegram Account & Session Management
epics.jtbd: When an admin sets up the platform, I want to manage Telegram accounts securely, so that I can dispatch outreach campaigns without triggering global bans.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce account ban rate from baseline to <5%
requirements: R1: Add new Telegram accounts via OTP UI or uploading pre-authenticated session files.
R2: Bind dedicated IPv4/IPv6 proxies to each account.
R3: Track real-time account health status (Active, Spam-Block, Ban, Re-auth).
R4: Emulate human behavior with randomized pauses and typing status.
R5: Enforce strict daily messaging rate limits per account.

slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease integration failure risk from unknown to documented

epics.title: Cold Outreach Campaign Engine
epics.jtbd: When an admin launches a campaign, I want to import leads and personalize templates, so that relevant outbound messages are delivered at scale.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase daily successful message deliveries by leveraging parallel sessions
requirements: R1: Import lead target lists via .csv/.txt or manual entry.
R2: Process Spintax message templates for randomization.
R3: Use LLM to dynamically rephrase first-offer outreach based on lead profile.
R4: Automatically rotate sessions on flood errors or limits.

epics.title: AI Dialogue Engine
epics.jtbd: When a lead replies to a cold message, I want the AI to conduct a natural conversation, so that unqualified leads are filtered and qualified ones are identified.
requirements: R1: Background listener for incoming Telegram responses.
R2: Persist conversation context (last N turns) in DB for LLM.
R3: Configurable system prompt (persona, goal, rules).
R4: Stop-triggers for intents (booking, objection) or max turns.
R5: Mark dialog as 'Awaiting Human Intervention' on stop-triggers.

epics.title: Anti-Ban & Account Warm-up System
epics.jtbd: When maintaining a pool of Telegram accounts, I want them to simulate human activity automatically, so that their trust scores improve and ban rates drop.
requirements: R1: Automated background actions (subscribe, read, online presence) to warm up accounts.
R2: Strict filter requiring 1-3 months of history for outreach tasks.
R3: Calculate variable non-linear delays (exponential distribution) between actions.
